plugin.title: System Manager
plugin.description: Manage system settings, domains and secrets.

phrases.system_settings_help: Global values used by the Kami installation. Domain-overridable values can be changed for individual sites.
phrases.languages_help: Choose which languages are available to sites in this Kami installation.
phrases.domains_help: Manage sites, their aliases and domain-specific settings.
phrases.secrets_help: Encrypted credentials stored by SecretStore. Existing values are never displayed.
phrases.title: Title
phrases.domain_overrides_help: Enable an override only when this domain should differ from the global value.
phrases.setting_usergroup_root_help: System group that bypasses normal access checks.
phrases.setting_usergroup_guest_help: System group used for unauthenticated visitors.
phrases.setting_default_timezone_help: Default display timezone. Server-side processing remains in UTC.
phrases.setting_cache_enabled_help: Default policy for domain application caching. The cache backend itself is configured in config.php.
phrases.setting_cache_ttl_help: Default domain application cache lifetime in seconds.
phrases.setting_usergroup_default_help: Global group assigned to newly registered users.
phrases.setting_default_language_help: Primary language used when no language is explicitly selected.
phrases.setting_lifecycle_plugins_help: Plugins initialized for every page request even when they are not used by a wrapper.
phrases.setting_system_custom_code_help: Trusted raw HTML exposed through the system_custom_code template parameter. Script tags are allowed.
